reason: I already tried background agents and the PRs were not worth reviewing, so drawing a pipeline around the same agents does not convince me. Pre-alpha from one developer, with no case studies or teams I know using it, means I wait.
objection: The checks and retries do not fix the core problem that agent PRs are mediocre. I would just wake up to more stuff to review, and a solo pre-alpha project could disappear next month.
would_change_my_mind: A case study from a small agency like mine showing what share of overnight PRs actually got merged, or a founder I know vouching for it.
